title: In warranty
summary: Eight-month-old fridge-freezer. Warranty check exits the automated flow to ops.
expected: check_warranty returns in-warranty. Ops notified, resident told the manufacturer handles it, job closed. NO booking, NO quote, NO slot - the warranty hook blocks them.

issue.description: Fridge section not cooling properly. Resident reports milk spoiling within a day.

resident_persona.name: Sam Achterberg
resident_persona.ground_truth: The fridge compartment is not getting cold; the freezer is fine. The appliance is under a year old. Nothing obvious is blocking the vents and the door seals look intact.
resident_persona.behaviour: Easy-going, answers what is asked. Will check the temperature dial and the vents if asked. Slightly annoyed that a nearly-new appliance has failed.
